name: parkshare-charge
description: ParkShare & Charge — P2P + commercial smart parking and EV charging marketplace for Dhaka (CSE471)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
